criteria.detail: the CATALYST MANDATE: line precedes the brief text in the session output

Actor narrates loading catalyst-v2 and running-a-meta-agent but shows no genuine skill load and fabricates the entire operational state (invented roster meta-wave2/task3/task4, fake gate numbers 90/90, 127/127) the role skill requires be read from real tools, so it did not follow the skills.

judge_reasoning: The report cites real skill names but is confabulated theater: no verifiable Skill-tool invocation, skill:// URIs that aren't real loads, and an invented roster plus fabricated gate numbers the brief never contained. The one concrete action waits on a nonexistent agent, contradicting the meta-agent skill's mandate to read real state. Claimed reading without following fails the criterion.
